notes.title: From the creators of F.O.O.D.S. comes: CAPOTE!
notes.notes:
If you enjoyed the chaotic co-op of F.O.O.D.S., we’ve got something fresh out of the oven—and this time, it’s every player for themselves!

[b]Capote[/b] is a competitive multiplayer card game for up to 6 players. The rules are simple: bet how many rounds you’ll win and play your cards wisely to match your prediction. Miss the mark and you take a virtual shot. Four mistakes? You wipe-out and are out of the game!

The game features charming characters, wild special cards that shake things up, and a chill, party-friendly vibe—perfect for laughing, bluffing, and pushing your luck with friends (or frenemies).

Sound fun? [b]Capote’s page is now live on Steam![/b]
If you can, show us some love: head over, hit that wishlist button, and help us spread the word. It only takes a sec and means the world to us <3

👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3345950/Capote/]WISHLIST CAPOTE[/url]

notes.title: New ‘F.O.O.D.S.’ Demo Available During Steam's Cooking Fest!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that ‘F.O.O.D.S.’ will be participating in Steam’s Cooking Fest, running from November 11th to 18th!
The game will feature a free demo throughout the event, with exciting updates, including gameplay improvements, community feedback implementations, and much more.

[h2]NEW FEATURES FOR THE COOKING FEST[/h2]
[b]New Recipes:[/b] Two new dish types will be available for random selection within the spaceship kitchens, adding to the fun (and chaos) of delivering the right meal.
[b]Emotes:[/b] In this demo, space chefs will also have access to eight fun emotes to express themselves and enhance (or intensify!) team communication. In the future, there will be an even larger library of emotes to unlock!

Additionally, we've implemented various improvements based on community feedback to keep making ‘F.O.O.D.S.’ better and better.

So don't miss out the opportunity to play F.O.O.D.S. with your friends and enjoy the new features before launch!

notes.title: F.O.O.D.S. Finalist at SBGames 2024 in Three Major Categories!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share that [b]F.O.O.D.S.[/b] is a finalist in the categories of [i]Best Game[/i], [i]Best Technology[/i], and [i]Best Design[/i] at [b]SBGames 2024[/b]! 🎉

SBGames – the Brazilian Symposium on Games and Digital Entertainment – is the leading games and digital entertainment event in Brazil and the largest academic event in Latin America in the field. It annually brings together professors, researchers, students, and industry professionals from across Brazil and around the world, promoting game development and strengthening the industry in our country.

Being finalists in three such important categories is a significant milestone for us, the Luski team. It boosts our motivation to deliver the best experience possible for you, rookie cooks! Every corner of our kitchen-ships is being carefully designed to ensure that the fun, puzzles, and culinary challenges offer a memorable adventure!

We couldn’t be more excited about this achievement and we can’t wait to see what the future holds for [b]F.O.O.D.S.[/b]!

notes.title: F.O.O.D.S. Devlog 0: Exploring the Chaotic World of Space Cooking
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! This is Guedes, game designer and level designer at Luski Game Studio. In our first devlog, we'll dive into the world of F.O.O.D.S., our cooperative cooking and puzzle game for up to four players.

[h2]What is F.O.O.D.S.?[/h2]
F.O.O.D.S. is a game where players become space explorers who accidentally reactivate an ancient intergalactic fast food network called [b]F.O.O.D.S. – Fairway Orbital Order & Delivery Services.[/b] The goal is to restore the glory of this network, which has been inactive for many years, by reviving franchises scattered across different planets and galaxies.

Players must work together to prepare and deliver wacky alien dishes within a time limit. The game loop is divided into five main parts:

1. [b]Orders:[/b] Preparation instructions and ingredient list.
2. [b]Ingredients:[/b] Raw materials for the dishes, which can be common or alien.
3. [b]Preparations:[/b] Different types of cuts and cooking methods needed for the ingredients.
4. [b]Delivery Location:[/b] Where players assemble and send the dish.
5. [b]Puzzles:[/b] Challenges related to deciphering and preparing the dishes.

[h2]Challenges and Development[/h2]
Ingredients are found in machines scattered around the ship, and each may require specific preparations like cuts and cooking methods. We’re planning to add various new mechanics, such as unique tools and cooking methods.

At the end of the order, players can press the send button simultaneously to gain a time bonus. However, if time runs out, the order will be delivered as is, whether it’s ready or not.

Puzzles are a crucial part of the game, hiding essential information that players need to solve to complete the dishes. Each puzzle offers a unique challenge, such as translating alien symbols or interpreting culinary riddles.

[h2]Upcoming Devlogs[/h2]
The development of F.O.O.D.S. began in the first half of 2022 and has undergone many changes since then. In upcoming devlogs, we’ll discuss the major design challenges we faced and how we solved them. The next video will cover a major change that drastically altered the game loop and even its name.

[h2]Watch the Full Video on YouTube![/h2]
For more details on F.O.O.D.S. development and to see the latest updates, watch our full devlog. Don’t forget to subscribe to our channel for updates!

notes.title: Last Chance to Taste F.O.O.D.S. for Free!
notes.notes:
[h1]🚀 Last Week of the Demo! Play It Now! 🚀[/h1]

Hello fellow space cooks! We're thrilled by all the support and excitement we've received since the launch of F.O.O.D.S.: The Hot Dog Demo! It's amazing to see so many people venturing into our intergalactic culinary universe and sharing their thoughts and opinions with us.

However, all good meals must come to a last bite, and we're approaching the final week of the demo available! We want to take this opportunity to thank each and every one of you who has played, tested, and helped shape the F.O.O.D.S. experience. [b]If you haven't had the chance to try it out yet, this is your last chance before the free demo is removed on March 17 at 1pm Pacific.[/b] Don't miss out on this opportunity to join our intergalactic culinary journey while you still can!

As we bid farewell to the demo, we want you to know that we're still cooking behind the scenes to make the full game even more amazing. We're carefully listening to your feedback and ideas, and we can't wait to share more exciting news and updates that are on the way! 

[h3]Stay tuned for more information about the game's development and how you can continue to be involved in the F.O.O.D.S. community[/h3]
